messages:
leo.k: Heads-up: OrchidLM (community checkpoint) requested listing on CloudWave marketplace + two SI bundles (NimbusSI & Integratech). Legal asked we lock redistribution & binary-derivative terms before we hand over artifacts. Quick sync?

marco.pm: Product asks we make a clear matrix of what partners can do: (1) host as a service, (2) embed in appliances, (3) redistribute weights as part of a managed offer. We prefer (1) and (2) by default; (3) only if they sign reseller addendum.

anita.legal: High-level legal approach: non-exclusive redistribution by default for hosting, with express prohibition on standalone resale of raw weights. For binary-derivatives (optimized kernels/compiled libs) require a derivative-binary license that forbids relicensing and mandates attribution + compatibility labeling. I'll draft.

tess.eng: Tech constraints: if SIs will ship quantized builds we supply, we need deterministic build metadata and provenance. Suggest embedding a signed manifest (json + ed25519 signature) inside the artifact. Example manifest fields: `artifact_id`, `source_hash`, `quant_scheme`, `build_time`, `signer`.

mike.hw: Hardware note: Appliance partners (EdgeBox, TitanRack) will request firmware-bundled kernels. We must ensure HSM/KMS usage for signing so partners can't alter bundle certificates. Also check export control if we ship certain optimized xpu code (some kernels flagged ECC/crypto libs).

yana.sales: Sales wants the marketplace blurb to allow partners to request a 21-day regional GTM window where we emphasize partner placement. We can't promise distribution exclusivity but can offer featured placement + email campaign. Need legal language that supports that.

anita.legal: OK on the 21-day GTM promo window as a commercial addendum. For marketplace copy we need a short approved line. Draft: "OrchidLM redistributed by Redwood Inference under a non-exclusive license. Partners must comply with attribution and may not resell raw model weights; contact partnerships@redwood.ai for commercial placement."

marco.pm: Timeline proposal: legal sign-off D, engineering artifact + manifest D+2, SI integration smoke D+6, partner-bundle upload D+9, marketplace soft-listing D+11, public announcement D+15. Prefer one-week buffer for SI fixes.

leo.k: Two operational asks: (A) create a partner onboarding checklist for NimbusSI/Integratech, (B) put an audit hook in listing so we can see usage-per-bundle at marketplace level for 90 days.

tess.eng: For checklist A: include required manifest signing, required compat matrix (cpu/gpu/quant), minimum test prompts + expected outputs (sanity checks), and regression report contact. We'll provide a sample test harness (pytest style).

ci-bot: Uploaded sample test harness to /internal/partner-assets/orchid/test_harness_v1.tar.gz and published `manifest-spec-v1.json`.

mike.hw: Confirmed EdgeBox supports `q4_0` and `int8awq`; TitanRack prefers `q4_v2` and requires AVX512 kernel. We'll need two kernel artifacts. Note: TitanRack's legal team asked about EULA compatibility for derivative binaries.

anita.legal: We'll add EULA compatibility checks to the SI checklist: partners must confirm their distro EULAs don't permit downstream relicensing. Also adding a short delist & remediation clause: Redwood can request temporary delisting if partner-hosted variant causes reproducible model safety or quality regressions; partner then has 72 hours to remediate or extended delist.

yana.sales: For enterprise partners asking for limited redistribution control, can we offer region-limited reseller rights for specific customers (timeboxed) as part of an enterprise MSA? Would need legal + commercial addendum.

anita.legal: We can do region/time-limited reseller rights via a negotiated addendum with audit rights and revocation clauses. Not default.

marco.pm: Marketing wants a one-liner we can include in marketplace metadata that is less legal-sounding. Anita, can you produce both: legal blurb and marketing-friendly copy?

anita.legal: Sure. Marketing copy: "OrchidLM on Redwood Inference — production-ready community model, available via marketplace partners. See listing for redistribution and GTM details." Legal blurb as earlier.

leo.k: Action items summary:
- Anita: distro clause + derivative-binary license + delist SLA + marketing/legal blurbs (due Wed EOD)
- Tess: manifest signing spec + test harness + compat matrix + sample kernels placeholder (due Tue)
- Mike: confirm HW kernel constraints and note any export/EULA blockers (due Tue)
- Marco/Yana: partner timeline + feature placement options + collect any GTM exclusivity asks (due Fri)

ci-bot: Created issue #partners-orchid-001 with checklist template and assignees.

leo.k: OK let's treat this thread as ground-truth for the onboarding plan. Ping me if anything slips. Thanks all :rocket:
